stations.name: Taipei, Taiwan
stations.selection_reason: Southwest ray and nearest selected station, chosen for geographic coverage.

observed_pick.recording_match: Station code matched. Upstream pick reports network IR and omits channel and location; it does not identify this particular BHZ trace. IU.00.BHZ is an independent open recording at the station and event-time epoch.

processing: Ignore zero-sample MiniSEED records and join exactly contiguous positive-sample records. No gaps are interpolated.
Convert raw integer instrumental counts to float64.
Remove the least-squares linear trend over the complete trace.
Apply a cosine taper to 2 percent at each end, limited to 30 seconds.
Apply a 4-corner, zero-phase Butterworth bandpass at 0.02 to 0.2 Hz.
Resample 20 Hz to 1 Hz with scipy.signal.resample_poly, up=1, down=20, window=('kaiser', 5.0), padtype='constant'. This includes an anti-alias FIR filter.
Round the displayed count samples to three decimal places. Preserve the raw MiniSEED separately.

challenge.arrival_rule: Earliest modeled uppercase P arrival at the candidate distance.
challenge.objective: Equal-weight root-mean-square residual in seconds, after fitting a common origin-time offset to the selected manual picks.
limitations: Depth is fixed at 29 km and receivers are modeled at the surface of spherical IASP91.
Origin-time offset is fitted from observations and is not treated as known.
Upstream manual picks have no stated time uncertainty. Equal weighting is an exercise choice, not a measurement of confidence.
The QuakeML network IR and absent channel do not identify a specific sensor. Recordings are independently matched by station code and event-time StationXML.
The historical catalog location is a reference, not an exact answer guaranteed by these eight picks and a one-dimensional model.
Residual contours and station-dropout differences are sensitivity displays, not calibrated statistical confidence regions.
Observed amplitudes are filtered instrumental counts without response removal. They are not comparable ground-motion measurements.
Zero-phase filtering may spread energy before an onset. Analyst picks come from the archived phase file, not this display filter or model.

provenance.credit: Albuquerque Seismological Laboratory/USGS (1988), Global Seismograph Network (GSN - IRIS/USGS), doi:10.7914/SN/IU. Recordings accessed through the EarthScope-operated data service. Manual P picks and event parameters from USGS ANSS phase data.

data_policy.basis: The IU DOI identifies Albuquerque Seismological Laboratory/USGS as creator. USGS-authored or produced data are in the U.S. public domain. Source attribution is retained.
data_policy.note: An empty DOI rights list is not a Creative Commons license declaration.

provenance.distance_convention: Spherical geographic great-circle distance without geocentric latitude correction.
